steps.en: The signed AOS is sent to the OIC's dashboard
steps.id: AOS yang sudah ditandatangani dikirim ke dashboard OIC
steps.why_en: No routing action or AOS queue exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aksi routing atau antrean AOS.

steps.en: The OIC has a dedicated role to receive AOS work
steps.id: OIC punya role khusus untuk menerima pekerjaan AOS
steps.why_en: No such role or function is defined in the repos.
steps.why_id: Role atau function itu tidak didefinisikan di repo.

steps.en: The OIC sees the routed AOS on their dashboard
steps.id: OIC melihat AOS yang dirutekan di dashboard-nya
steps.why_en: The dashboard has no AOS list.

steps.en: The OIC signs the AOS electronically
steps.why_en: No electronic signing exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada penandatanganan elektronik di sistem.

steps.en: The OIC can download or print the signed AOS
steps.id: OIC bisa mengunduh atau mencetak AOS yang sudah ditandatangani
steps.why_en: No AOS document is generated or offered for download.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada dokumen AOS yang dibuat atau disediakan untuk diunduh.
